name: Yuvomi
description:
Yuvomi is a private, self-hosted family planner — one calm home for everything your household needs to stay organized. No cloud accounts, no subscriptions, no tracking: your data lives on your server and nowhere else.

REQUIRED: Set a long random SESSION_SECRET.
RECOMMENDED: Set a strong DB_ENCRYPTION_KEY to encrypt the database at rest — without it the database and any synced calendar/contact credentials are stored unencrypted.
Generate either secret with: openssl rand -base64 48

After the container starts, open the WebUI — the first visit guides you through creating your admin account. (Headless setups can alternatively run node setup.js in the container console.) Then log in — pick the modules you want and invite your family.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Database and stored app data (uploads, documents).

paths.name: Backups
paths.description: Destination folder for scheduled and manual database backups.

paths.name: Modules (optional)
paths.description: Optional: drop-in folder for additional Yuvomi modules. Leave default if unused.

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: Host port for the Yuvomi web interface.

variables.name: SESSION_SECRET
variables.description: REQUIRED. A long random string used to sign sessions. Generate with: openssl rand -base64 48

variables.name: DB_ENCRYPTION_KEY
variables.description: RECOMMENDED. Strong key to encrypt the database at rest (SQLCipher). Leave empty for unencrypted SQLite. Cannot be changed later without re-encrypting. Generate with: openssl rand -base64 48

variables.name: Timezone
variables.description: Container timezone, e.g. Europe/Berlin. Affects scheduled backups and reminders.

variables.name: SESSION_SECURE
variables.description: Use 1 behind one reverse proxy (Caddy/nginx/Traefik), or 'loopback' for direct (no proxy) access.

variables.name: DB_PATH
variables.description: Path to the SQLite database inside the container. Keep default unless you know what you are doing.

variables.name: SESSION_SECURE
variables.description: Set to true only when serving Yuvomi over HTTPS behind a reverse proxy. Keep false for direct HTTP access on the LAN.

variables.name: TRUST_PROXY
variables.description: Use 1 behind one reverse proxy (Caddy/nginx/Traefik), or 'loopback' for direct (no proxy) access.

variables.name: TRUST_PROXY
variables.description: Use 1 behind one reverse proxy (Caddy/nginx/Traefik), or 'loopback' for direct (no proxy) access.

variables.name: BASE_URL
variables.description: Optional but required for password-reset emails to be sent. Absolute origin used to build reset links, e.g. https://yuvomi.example.com. The request Host header is never trusted as a fallback, to prevent reset-link poisoning.

variables.name: FIXER_API_KEY
variables.description: Optional. Fixer API key for live currency conversion in Budget → Subscriptions. Rates are cached for 12 hours; works without this key using the cached/manual rate.
